label: November 10
title: The Life Church Started Weekly Services
paragraph: The Life Church of Memphis officially began on November 10, 1996. Pastors John and Leslie Siebeling, along with seven others who moved to Memphis earlier that year, stepped out in faith, believing that God would use them to reach people in the city and beyond. On that first Sunday, 152 showed up and the church was officially born.
stat: The church met weekly at the Homebuilders Association Building on Germantown Parkway

label: Summer
title: Sent First Global Missions Team
paragraph: The Life Church sent its first short-term missions team to Nairobi, Kenya, beginning a legacy of serving people and taking the hope of Jesus around the world.
stat: 209 different teams sent on mission trips since 1998

label: January
title: Leased Office Space in Cordova
paragraph: The Life Church leased its first office space, customizing the space under construction on Bonnie Lane to include a large room for church meetings and prayer. This was a major step in the history of the church as it marked the first semi-permanent space we could call our own. At just over two years old, The Life Church was seeing growth in small groups, water baptisms and in reaching new families in the city.
stat: 16 cell groups meeting, with an average of 160 people attending

label: Fall
title: Leased First Billboard
paragraph: The Life Church launched Reaching Forward in Faith, its first giving campaign focused on our church’s future, and placed its first billboard on Germantown Parkway in front of the Home Builders Association Building. Through a series of events, this billboard led to major steps towards a permanent facility for Sunday worship services.
stat: The Home Builders Association Building was demolished and rebuilt as a CVS Pharmacy

label: October 28
title: Celebrated 5 Years as a Church
paragraph: The Life Church celebrated five years of ministry in Memphis, giving thanks for all God had done and looking ahead to all He would do. At the time, our church was beginning to see real momentum and growth and was preparing to move into our first permanent facility on Germantown Parkway.
stat: Headed into the 5th anniversary with 21 days of prayer and fasting, then 24 hours of prayer straight through

label: March 31
title: Hosted First Service at Permanent Building
paragraph: The Life Church moved into its first building in Cordova. This space became a hub for our church and would later be the catalyst for launching multiple new locations. In this facility, we experienced unprecedented growth and at one point hosted six worship services every weekend to accommodate the number of people attending.
stat: Before renovations, the building was a Jitney Premier grocery store

label: September 22
title: Hosted Reinhard Bonnke For Miracle Service
paragraph: The Life Church hosted evangelist Reinhard Bonnke for a special Miracle Service, creating a powerful moment of ministry and faith for our church.
stat: Bonnke’s ministry documented more than 79 million salvation decisions

label: Spring
title: Launched Axis Student Ministries
paragraph: The Life Church started a youth ministry for students in 6th–12th grade. What began as a small, weekly gathering of a handful of teenagers has turned into a true movement — impacting tens of thousands of students over the past 20+ years.
stat: Axis now meets regularly on four continents

label: August
title: Launched Leadership Internship Program
paragraph: Recognizing the importance of developing leaders in God’s House, The Life Church established the Damascus Road internship program (renamed Life Leadership) to mentor and train the next generation of Christian leaders.
stat: 690 students graduated across the 20 years

label: September
title: Canceled Sunday Services to Serve
paragraph: In response to Hurricane Katrina, The Life Church canceled regular Sunday morning services and mobilized volunteers and resources to serve those affected by the storm in Biloxi, Mississippi and Baton Rouge, Louisiana.
stat: Over 300 church members made the trip to serve

label: Early
title: Launched TV Program
paragraph: Extending its reach beyond weekend services at the Germantown Parkway location, The Life Church began broadcasting services on television, bringing the worship and teaching experience to thousands of homes across the region.

label: March 6–7
title: Hosted First Make Room Event
paragraph: The Life Church launched Make Room, a ministry designed to equip and inspire pastors and other church leaders to build the local church, develop their teams and grow their leadership. Over the years, Make Room has grown into an international ministry helping thousands of pastors and leaders all over the world.
stat: In 2026, over 1,000 pastors and church leaders attended a Make Room event

label: March 23
title: Launched Collierville Location at YMCA
paragraph: As The Life Church continued to reach capacity at the location in Cordova, we were able to launch a second location at the YMCA at Schilling Farms in Collierville. This location eventually became Houston Levee. For the first time, our church was one church in more than one location.

label: July 13–16
title: Hosted First Axis Conference
paragraph: The Life Church held the first Axis Youth Conference (renamed Axis Nation and then Axis Conference) for students in 6th–12th grade, beginning an annual multi-day event for the next generation to encounter God. The first conference hosted just over 200 students and was the beginning of a national movement of young people that now reaches thousands of students and dozens of churches every summer.
stat: Pastor Matthew Barnett of the Los Angeles Dream Center was the opening night speaker

label: Fall
title: Launched FeedMemphis Outreach Initiative
paragraph: With a burden to solve the food insecurity crisis in Memphis, The Life Church launched FeedMemphis, an ongoing outreach initiative to meet the practical needs of the city. The church rallied with radical generosity and was able to purchase multiple trucks that were filled with bags of groceries and taken to local schools every Friday.
stat: Memphis was named the “Hunger Capital of the United States” in 2010, with 26% of the metro area struggling to afford food

label: February 9
title: Launched East Memphis Location
paragraph: The Life Church opened a new location in East Memphis at the Malco Paradiso Theatre, expanding to our third location in the Memphis area. After meeting in a movie theatre for seven months, we were miraculously able to purchase the current Highland location property from Victory University.
stat: The 7-acre campus was founded in 1941 as the Mid-South Bible Center, and later became a church Elvis Presley attended

label: May 25
title: Launched The Life Church — Santiago
paragraph: The Life Church opened an international location in Santiago, Chile, extending the church’s reach outside of the United States. Led by Pastors Josh and Jessica Fuentes, The Life Church — Santiago has been a beacon of hope and a place of life-change for one of the largest cities on the continent of South America.
stat: Launched on Pastor John’s birthday

label: September 18–20
title: Hosted First Zoe Conference
paragraph: The Life Church launched Life Women’s Conference (now Zoe Conference), a gathering for ladies of all ages to encounter God and grow in strength, friendship and purpose. One major part of the conference was Pastor Leslie Siebeling’s heart to launch the Life Women’s Foundation — a fund designed to bless and lift up women every year.
stat: Charlotte Gambill and Anthony Evans joined as guests for the inaugural year

label: August
title: Started Read to Lead After-School Program
paragraph: The Life Church launched an after-school literacy and leadership program, creating opportunities for underserved children in the Raleigh community. This program has served hundreds of children and walks with the students year over year through every grade, with the goal of helping them increase their reading levels and grow as leaders.
stat: In its first eight years, 83.3% of the children saw reading scores rise and school suspensions fall

label: December
title: Hosted First Sound of Christmas
paragraph: The Life Church launched The Sound of Christmas, an annual production bringing spectacular music and a message of hope to the Christmas season. Each year, thousands of people from the community make the Sound of Christmas a part of their holiday tradition.
stat: Nearly all of the vocalists, choir, musicians and dancers are volunteers and staff of The Life Church

label: May
title: Broke Ground on New Houston Levee Facility
paragraph: The Life Church embarked on the largest and most significant project to date: a brand new 52,000-square-foot worship space that increased the size of the auditorium at the Houston Levee location from approximately 450 seats to over 2,000.
stat: The church met in the original Collierville building for seven years before expanding

label: September 9–10
title: Houston Levee Auditorium Grand Opening
paragraph: After over a year of construction, The Life Church opened our new Houston Levee facility. This step marked a significant stake in the ground in the city of Memphis and would eventually become the hub for the global expansion God would bring to our church.
stat: The first building we designed ourselves

label: April 21
title: Launched the Austin Peay Location
paragraph: The Life Church opened a new location on Austin Peay Highway, expanding our presence to the Raleigh area of Memphis and making it possible to reach more people. Today, over 1,000 people call that location their home each Sunday.
stat: Launched by merging with The House Church

label: Summer
title: Sent a Record 21 Global Mission Teams
paragraph: The Life Church sent 21 mission teams around the world, taking the Gospel to the nations and serving communities across five continents. Hundreds of people from our church got the opportunity to travel around the world on short-term trips and see God do incredible things.
stat: Colombia, Cuba, Ethiopia, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Japan and Zimbabwe

label: April 12
title: Launched The Life Church — New York
paragraph: The Life Church established our first location in New York with Lead Pastors Wayne and Classy Francis, expanding the church’s reach from the South to the Northeast. Pastors Wayne and Classy felt called to join their church, previously called Authentic Church, to The Life Church family. In 2023, we opened a permanent facility on Mamaroneck Avenue that has led to an increase of over 700% in attendance in the last 3 years.
stat: Merged with Authentic Church and launched during the COVID-19 pandemic

label: September
title: Launched Leadership in Black & White Podcast
paragraph: Pastor John and Pastor Wayne started a podcast to discuss topics to help Christian leaders grow. A part of the K-LOVE podcast family, episodes are released every Monday and cover subjects like church, ministry, family, relationships and more.
stat: 215 episodes released to date

label: October 17
title: Launched The Life Church — Massachusetts
paragraph: The Life Church opened a location in Massachusetts with Lead Pastor Emy Vazquez. Formerly Excel Church, this location was just outside of Boston and became the second in the Northeast. In 2025, we moved into our first permanent facility in Fitchburg and attendance has nearly tripled in less than two years.

label: November 10
title: Celebrated 25th Anniversary
paragraph: The Life Church celebrated 25 years of ministry, a significant milestone and moment to look back at all that God had done. At the time of the celebration, The Life Church had seven locations around the world. Just five years later, our church has grown to 12 locations with more on the way.
stat: Two future locations — Italy and DC Metro — were announced during the weekend celebration

label: January 30
title: Launched The Life Church — Italy
paragraph: The Life Church established a location in Florence, Italy with Pastors Marco and Tiina Geraci, expanding the church’s international reach into Europe. Today, The Life Church — Italy is one of the largest churches in all of Florence and hosts both an Italian-speaking and English-speaking service.
stat: Pastor Marco was born in Sicily and Pastor Tiina in Finland

label: June
title: Axis Conference Sold Out
paragraph: Axis Conference reached capacity at 2,000 students for the first time, marking a significant milestone in the conference’s growth beyond a local youth conference. Today, more than 40 churches around the country bring their students to participate in Axis Conference every summer.

label: January
title: Hosted First Revival Nights
paragraph: The Life Church launched Revival Nights, powerful services to encounter God’s presence through worship, teaching and prayer. These nights have served as incredible conclusions to our annual 21 Days of Fasting & Prayer.
stat: Guests have included Chad Veach, Israel Houghton, Charlotte Gambill, Dr. Manny Arango, Leeland Mooring, Dino Rizzo and Rich Wilkerson, Jr.

label: March 19
title: Launched The Life Church — DC Metro
paragraph: The Life Church opened a location serving the DC metropolitan area, expanding our US presence into the nation’s capital. In the last two years, this location has grown by more than 50% while meeting in a local school.

label: March 19–20
title: Hosted First International Make Room Event
paragraph: The Life Church took Make Room internationally for the first time, hosting the leadership event for pastors and church leaders in Santiago, Chile. Just two months later, we hosted our second international Make Room event in Florence, Italy.
stat: Over 30 churches represented and more than 200 pastors and leaders from across South America

label: March 3
title: Launched The Life Church — South Africa
paragraph: The Life Church opened our third international location in Johannesburg, South Africa, led by Pastors Adrian and Leigh Wright. This became a step toward the fulfillment of a powerful prophecy Pastors John and Leslie received about returning to the continent of Africa.

label: March 31
title: Launched First Prison Location
paragraph: The Life Church established a location at the Shelby County Division of Corrections, bringing the hope of Jesus to incarcerated men through weekly Sunday services. Since launch, we have hosted multiple baptism services and seen hundreds of men surrender their lives to Jesus.

label: June
title: Released Axis Worship Original Song
paragraph: Axis Worship released its first original song, marking a creative milestone for our church’s student worship ministry. “Overflow” has since been streamed nearly 200,000 times across all platforms.
stat: The debut EP, “Songs For Wednesday”, was released at Axis Conference in 2026

label: September 8
title: Launched The Life Church — Nashville
paragraph: The Life Church opened a location in the Bellevue area of Nashville. This location began meeting in the summer of 2024 and officially launched in September, with a beautiful building already designed to support continued growth and reach people throughout the Nashville community.

label: February 23
title: Launched Second Prison Location
paragraph: The Life Church expanded our prison ministry with a second location serving inmates at the 201 Poplar facility. This location hosts five services each Sunday with hundreds of men participating every week.

label: August 8
title: Groundbreaking for Global Hub & Next Gen Building
paragraph: The Life Church began construction on the Global Hub & Next Generation Building, a 50,000-square-foot facility with increased kids space, office and creative workspace, meeting space and more. Once completed, this facility will serve as the Global Hub for our expanding and growing church around the world.
stat: It will double our capacity to host next generation ministries

label: September 1
title: Launched Life Leadership Bible School
paragraph: The Life Church launched Life Leadership Bible School, a two-year online program designed to help people grow in theology, ministry, and leadership.
stat: Over 370 students from seven countries enrolled in the inaugural class
